concepts.title: 01  Classic Diagonal
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design ONE new GentlePath logo variation based very closely on the supplied reference image.
Reference image role: the user's selected favorite identity, a square badge of TWO interlocking rounded jigsaw pieces, dark forest upper-left with an ivory capital G, muted lavender lower-right with an ivory capital P, a narrow ivory diagonal seam and recognisable round jigsaw tab-and-socket connections. The reference shows the same identity in three applications. It is visual source material only.
Brand: GentlePath, an app and website for families navigating autism. The user specifically likes this bold, solid two-piece GP badge. Keep that family resemblance; develop the exact variation described below with intentional differences in construction. Use a strong nearly-square silhouette, friendly precise rounded corners, big legible letters, and confident optical balance. A capital P has an upper bowl and a lower stem, with lower-right open negative space; never replace P with D. G and P are uppercase, no other initials.
Composition: landscape, around 3:2, high resolution. One calm warm ivory #FFFDF8 proof board with THREE large samples on a shared horizontal baseline: app icon at left, standalone symbol at center, symbol plus the word "GentlePath" at right. The wordmark area uses about half the width. The same exact emblem geometry and colors across all three samples; the app icon merely centers it in a softly rounded ivory square. Plenty of clear margins; the entire wordmark must fit without cropping. Small title at the top left exactly as provided. Under the three samples put the labels "App Icon", "Symbol", "Icon + Text". No extra text.
The wordmark is strongly crafted humanist sans, medium-bold, warm and contemporary, open counters, excellent kerning, title case exactly "GentlePath". Use dark forest ink, without a space in the name. Match the bold friendly clarity of the supplied wordmark.
Finish: clean flat vector-style logo proof, precise filled silhouettes and crisp negative space. No photorealism, texture, paper grain, gradients, lighting, shadows, bevels, mockups, device screens, scenery, trees, leaves, hearts, infinity symbols, tiny extra pieces, watermarks or copied external brand marks. Jigsaw connectors have an actual circular knob, a narrower neck and a matching socket. Keep gaps wide enough to survive icon scale. Exactly one identity concept on this board, not a collage of different designs.
Title (verbatim): "01  Classic Diagonal".
Variation to design: A disciplined refinement of the reference with a clean 45-degree ascending diagonal seam, one generous circular tab in the upper half and one smaller reverse tab in the lower half. Large G in the upper-left forest section, large P in the lower-right muted lavender section. The exterior is a perfect softly rounded square with continuous outer edges and no distortion. Slightly increase the seam width and letter counter openings for a clearer small app icon. This should be unmistakably related to the chosen reference but newly drawn, balanced and polished.
Palette: Reference forest #174E46, muted lavender #A79ABD, ivory #FFFDF8. Both G and P in ivory.

concepts.title: 11  Offset Building Blocks
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create an original logo concept for "GentlePath", a warm, memorable family app for parents navigating autism. The user explicitly requests BUILDING BLOCKS carrying G and P, OFFSET and STACKED in the app's own colors.
Reference image role: the user's favorite proof layout, strong uppercase G/P letters, friendly substantial geometry and warm identity. Use the three-sample presentation and typography character as a reference. For this new experiment, the emblem is actual simple BUILDING BLOCKS.
Specific symbol: exactly TWO chunky softly rounded toy-building-block cubes stacked as a compact stair-step tower. The UPPER cube is shifted LEFT, the LOWER cube is shifted RIGHT by about one-third of a cube width. The upper cube visibly rests on the lower cube's upper-left portion, physically plausible and connected. Upper cube's front face is deep forest #174E46 with a big ivory uppercase "G". Lower cube's front face is pale lilac #ECE2F6 with a big deep-forest uppercase "P". Show an extremely shallow consistent three-quarter view: a tiny side face and top face use actual sage #E0ECD9 and sunlight #F8DC94 to communicate building blocks. Use crisp flat ink planes, only 2 or 3 faces per cube; this is a reduced vector brand mark, not a photorealistic toy render. No studs, letters on side faces, wood grain, gloss, shading, perspective distortion, extra cubes or extra symbols. The FRONT letters G and P must be large, unmistakable and upright.
